svg.title: Figure 3-3: Where Communication Control Lives
svg.desc: Cloud Native Textbook Figure 3-3 — Where Communication Control Lives: Application Side vs. Service Mesh

g.text: ① Held by the Application Side
Communication logic is distributed across each service
② Delegated to the Infrastructure (Service Mesh)
Services are designed without awareness of communication control
▶ The complexity of communication control can be distributed across the application side, or consolidated into the infrastructure (Service Mesh).
Neither is correct. It is a design decision about where and by whom the complexity can be taken on.
The principle seen in Figure 3-1 — "Complexity moves" — applies equally to communication control.
